capstone.title: Your First Client Video
capstone.brief: Edit a full 2-minute video for a real or pretend small business. It is a short advert with a clear message, clean cuts, captions, music, and a call to action at the end.
checks: Video is 1 minute 45 to 2 minutes 15 long
Has a clear message in the first 5 seconds
Cuts are clean with no dead air
Captions are correct and easy to read
Music fits and does not hide the voice
Ends with a clear call to action
deliverables: A list of the clips and music used
A short note on what you would improve next time
